## SLIT Business Rules

- [ ] Reviewed new values, conditions, required fields, dropdowns, transitions, deadlines, payment terms and approvals for operational policy.
- [ ] Registered every new operational rule with a stable identifier and existing Admin menu mapping, created a safe draft, and linked the frontend and backend to the centralized evaluator.
- [ ] Verified with a test that an authorized administrator can change and publish the value and that the workflow enforces it without redeployment.
- [ ] Verified a repeat deployment preserves saved values, and non-admin and other-tenant writes are refused.
- [ ] Documented technical, security and regulatory exceptions near the code and obtained reviewer approval. Included the authoritative source for any regulatory requirement.
